# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary

Describe the change in one or two sentences.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Example
- [ ] Workflow
- [ ] Maintenance

## Review checks

- [ ] The change matches the public scope.
- [ ] Related docs still use consistent wording.
- [ ] Examples use placeholder data only.
- [ ] No production configuration is included.
- [ ] Follow-up work is tracked if needed.
